335:t_1:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...So this $$スコート・ラボ$$ is Dr. $$トライア$$'s research facility.」

335:t_1:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, that's right. It's known as the City Where Demons Cry.」

335:t_1:7.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Don't teach people lies, $$デュオ$$.」

335:t_1:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「The only one crying is $$クロウ$$!」

335:t_1:9.en:
$n
「Is that $$スコート・ラボ$$ connected to the $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ we keep hearing about?」

335:t_1:10.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes... $$クロウ$$ is a $$次元獣$$ Buster belonging to that laboratory, after all.」

335:t_1:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「His ride, the $$ブラスタ$$ series, is handmade by that Dr. Fox, too.」

335:t_1:12.en:
$$カトル$$
「She is now an authority on super-dimensional physics, but in the $$破界事変$$ she was a pro at mobile weapons development and $$次元獣$$ countermeasures.」

335:t_1:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She helped us out in the $$時獄戦役$$ too, but she really is something, isn't she?」

335:t_1:16.en:
$n
「Nothing... When I see her putting on that fox mask, she just doesn't look like such an eminent doctor, I was thinking...」

335:t_1:17.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There's a goofball hiding under a cool exterior around here too, so it's probably fine.」

335:t_1:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Good for you. Looks like you've managed to stop being the quiet type.」

335:t_1:25.en:
$$カレン$$
「Still, that was a lucky break. Dr. $$トライア$$ taking us in and offering to back us up.」

335:t_1:26.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Even though $$セントラル・ベース$$ is still standing in North America, the Federation and the Empire are still evenly matched there. We should be able to find other collaborators.」

335:t_1:27.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「There's also Brigadier General $$マネキン$$, Lieutenant $$パトリック$$'s wife.」

335:t_1:30.en:
$$五飛$$
「I agree with $$ヒイロ$$. With most of $c's whereabouts unknown right now, the war will gradually tilt toward the Empire.」

335:t_1:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's why we'll do our best. Until Captain $$アムロ$$, $$甲児$$ and the others come back.」

335:t_1:32.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Right. At this point, we can't afford to be picky, even if it's Dr. Fox.」

335:t_1:33.en:
$n
「Somehow $$デュオ$$ is really harsh in his opinion of Dr. $$トライア$$...」

335:t_1:34.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「He's probably sympathizing with $$クロウ$$.」

335:t_1:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「They're fellow members of the Short Straw Alliance, after all.」

335:t_1:36.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Shut up! That team disbanded ages ago!」

335:t_1:38.en:
$n
「I've heard it a few times already, but it seems to be a team they don't want known.」

335:t_1:41.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Nah... I've been curious about that Short Straw Alliance myself.」

335:t_1:42.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$青山$$ and $$ロックオン$$ kept pestering me to join up.」

335:t_1:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「You'll find out the truth before long.」

335:t_1:44.en:
$n
「Will it be revealed at $$スコート・ラボ$$?」

335:t_1:46.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm sure we'll run into that guy before long, too.」

335:t_1:51.en:
$$研究員$$
「...Welcome to $$スコート・ラボ$$. Maintenance on all your machines will begin right away.」

335:t_1:52.en:
$$研究員$$
「I've been put in sole charge of guiding you, so please bear with me.」

335:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is Dr. $$トライア・スコート$$ away?」

335:t_1:54.en:
$$研究員$$
「To spread the risk, the doctor is carrying out her research at a facility separate from this one.」

335:t_1:56.en:
$$スザク$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$'s power was a big part of why we were able to destroy the $$時の牢獄$$.」

335:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Since the Empire is presumably marking her as well, we should handle this with the highest level of alert.」

335:t_1:58.en:
$$研究員$$
「Exactly. The residents have also been evacuated on the Federation's orders, and the town is now almost completely deserted.」

335:t_1:59.en:
$$研究員$$
「Only lab personnel are in this area now.」

335:t_1:61.en:
$$研究員$$
「Yes... Thanks to that, our dangerous research is going well.」

335:t_1:62.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Dangerous research, huh... Coming from someone connected to Dr. Fox, that's not funny.」

335:t_1:63.en:
$$研究員$$
「For your reception today, an emissary from the doctor has been dispatched here.」

335:t_1:65.en:
$$研究員$$
「Now then, I'll show you the way.」

335:t_1:69.en:
$$デュオ$$
「And here I thought you were missing, but you were at Dr. Fox's place all along!」

335:t_1:71.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... it was an invitation from a beautiful woman, too. I couldn't exactly turn it down.」

335:t_1:72.en:
$$モーム$$
「Honestly, $$桂$$! Joking like that again!」

335:t_1:73.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Did Dr. $$トライア$$ invite you because you're a singularity?」

335:t_1:74.en:
$$桂$$
「Sharp as ever, $$ロジャー$$. That's right.」

335:t_1:75.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you were helping with the doctor's research.」

335:t_1:76.en:
$$桂$$
「Even after the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, I had no place to go home to...」

335:t_1:77.en:
$$桂$$
「On top of that, the $$サイデリアル$$ guys seemed hot for me and were chasing me around. So that's how I ended up taking the doctor up on her offer.」

335:t_1:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「But if you're here, $$桂$$, has the doctor's research reached a stopping point?」

335:t_1:80.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Apparently? You don't know what it was about either?」

335:t_1:81.en:
$$桂$$
「Right. I was pretty much a fish on the chopping board.」

335:t_1:82.en:
$$桂$$
「But dealing with the doctor was heavier than I ever imagined. Now that I've been released, I can finally relax.」

335:t_1:84.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah... I'm back in the field too.」

335:t_1:85.en:
$$桂$$
「With $c in a huge crisis, there's nothing to be done without a hero around.」

uncertain: Dr. Fox = Duo's nickname for Traia (no precedent)
